tools.description:
Get insured detail list from NowCerts by searching on name, address, phone, email, agent, or CSR.

1. If personal insured → searchText accepts any combination of first/last/commercial name
   (e.g. "Arthur", "Simpson", "Arthur Simpson", "Simpson, Arthur"). Address tokens can
   also be used to locate the insured.
2. If the user provides an email address (e.g. "who is MIKE6460@GMAIL.COM"), pass it via
   `email` — it matches the insured's eMail field (partial, case-insensitive).
3. If the user gives an agent's or CSR's name (e.g. "list insureds for agent John Smith",
   "which insureds does CSR Jane handle"), pass it via agent_name / csr_name. The endpoint
   returns the matching insureds' full details.
4. If multiple results → Show list, ask user to select.
5. Always surface insuredDatabaseId first when answering — it is the canonical insured ID
   used by every other tool. agents and csRs are always returned alongside it.
6. For general questions, lead with insuredDatabaseId then add the requested fields. For
   specific-field questions, return only those fields (plus insuredDatabaseId).

Args:
    searchText: Name of the insured to search for (optional). Also accepted as insured_name or name.
    insured_name: Alias for searchText — name of the insured to search for (optional)
    name: Alias for searchText — name of the insured to search for (optional)
    address_details: Address to search for (optional)
    phone: Phone number (10 digits without any separators and country code) to search for (optional)
    email: Email address to search for (optional). Partial, case-insensitive match against eMail.
    agent_name: Agent/producer name to filter insureds by (optional). Matches the insured's
        agents[].firstName / lastName. Pass "Jacob Harris" or just "Harris".
    csr_name: CSR name to filter insureds by (optional). Same matching rules as agent_name,
        against the insured's csRs[].
    type: "0" for Insured (default — excludes Prospects), "1" for Prospect only

Note: Provide at least one of searchText/insured_name/name, address_details, phone, email,
agent_name, or csr_name.

                      vehicle is removed. ("add a vehicle", "insured bought
                      another car, add it to the policy")
  VEHICLE_TRANSFER = an EXISTING listed vehicle's OWNERSHIP/TITLE status is
                      changing (e.g. moving from personal to business name or
                      vice versa). No VIN changes; nothing added or removed.

  "Do you have a publicly accessible URL for this file (e.g. from S3, Google Drive,
   Dropbox, or any hosted link)? Using a URL is much faster and uses far fewer tokens.
   If you don't have one, I can still proceed using base64, but it will be slow."

   characters). Passing them via Claude consumes a large number of tokens,
   significantly slows down the response, and may hit context limits.
   Only use this when the user has confirmed no public URL is available.

Images: JPG, JPEG, PNG

file_b64 is automatically masked in all logging and monitoring dashboards.
API key is passed via Authorization header: Bearer <api_key>

Args:
    file_url: Publicly accessible URL to the file (preferred, fast)
    file_b64: Base64-encoded file content (fallback, slow, high token cost)
    file_name: File name with extension — used to detect type (default: license.jpg)
